question.text: Pre-tax return is 12%; client's effective tax rate is 20%. Post-tax return is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Post-tax = Pre-tax × (1 - tax) = 12% × 0.80 = 9.6%. The Trap: Gross only is 12%. Cross-Exam Context: Basic tax math. Manager's Pro-Tip: Always present post-tax in client pitches — clients pay tax, not gross.
